"""Toolformer loss-filter implementation using NumPy."""

import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    with_result: np.ndarray,
    call_only: np.ndarray,
    no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call.

    Based on Toolformer's API call filtering: keep a candidate if the
    log-probability sum with the API call exceeds the no-call sum plus
    the threshold. The margin is the difference minus the threshold.
    """
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [
        (with_result, "with_result"),
        (call_only, "call_only"),
        (no_call, "no_call"),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (with_result.shape == call_only.shape == no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Compute sums along the future horizon axis
    sum_call = np.sum(call_only, axis=1)
    sum_with = np.sum(with_result, axis=1)
    sum_no = np.sum(no_call, axis=1)
    # Compute keep condition: keep if (sum_call+sum_with) > (sum_no + tau_filter)
    keep = (sum_call + sum_with) > (sum_no + tau_filter)
    margins = (sum_call + sum_with) - (sum_no + tau_filter)
    return keep, margins
